summary: **Ranks and Kits**: Explorer ranks are earned in game with /rankup, store ranks add perks and a daily rank kit, and kits are free gear on a timer.

blocks.p: Explorer ranks run from Tin to Prismatic. The store ranks are VIP, VIP+, MVP and MVP+.

`/ranks` shows every Explorer rank and what it needs. When you have done everything a rank asks for, run `/rankup`. Each rank up hands out rewards such as spawners and money, and raises how fast you earn [claim blocks](/wiki/smp/claims/).
Store ranks are bought on [the store](/store/). Each one includes everything in the rank below it.

ul: Tin (where everyone starts)

Prismatic (the final rank, which also gives an auto-sell chest)

blocks.p: Everyone starts with 3 homes. Silver raises that to 4 and Adamantine to 5. Each Explorer rank also shows as a tag after your name in chat.
Each store rank includes everything in the ranks below it, kits too.
**VIP**: [VIP] chat tag, 10 homes, 5 auto-sell chests, 2 player warps, `/hat`, `/near`, `/nick`, 1.25x mcMMO XP, 2 spawner storage pages, 150 upgradeable hoppers, and the VIP and Diamond kits.
**VIP+**: [VIP+] tag, 15 homes, 10 auto-sell chests, 3 player warps, `/enderchest`, `/itemname` with colour codes, 1.5x mcMMO XP, 3 spawner storage pages, 175 upgradeable hoppers, and the VIP+ kit.

**MVP**: [MVP] tag, 20 homes, 15 auto-sell chests, 8 player warps, formatting codes in chat, `/condense`, `/feed`, `/repair` and `/repair all`, `/workbench`, mcMMO abilities that last 12 seconds longer with halved cooldowns, the mcMMO Lucky perk, 5 spawner storage pages, 200 upgradeable hoppers, and the MVP kit.
**MVP+**: [MVP+] tag, 25 homes, 250 upgradeable hoppers, and the MVP+ kit.
Without a store rank you have 3 homes, 2 auto-sell chests, 1 player warp, 1 spawner storage page, 125 upgradeable hoppers and `/back` (also after death).
`/kit` lists the kits you can claim. Everyone can claim the Starter, Claim, Tools and Daily kits. Each kit has its own cooldown.

ul: {{icon:stone_pickaxe}} **Starter Kit**: stone tools, chainmail and leather armour, a Claim Shovel, a Claim Finder stick, a bed, 32 bread, a Chroma Key and a Shard Key, plus 30 minutes of Resistance, Saturation and Regeneration. Given once, on your first join.
{{icon:golden_shovel}} **Claim Kit**: a Claim Shovel to mark out land. Every minute.
{{icon:stone_pickaxe}} **Tools Kit**: a stone sword, shovel, pickaxe and axe. Every 10 minutes.
{{icon:iron_chestplate}} **Daily Kit**: a full set of iron armour and iron tools, plus 16 steak. Every 24 hours.
{{icon:diamond_chestplate}} **Diamond Kit**: diamond armour with Protection I, a Sharpness II sword and an Efficiency II pickaxe. Every 24 hours, with VIP and up.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **VIP Kit**: a Shard Key and 200 Prism Shards. Every 24 hours, with VIP and up.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **VIP+ Kit**: a Spawner Key and 500 Prism Shards. Every 24 hours, with VIP+ and up.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **MVP Kit**: a Chroma Key and 750 Prism Shards. Every 24 hours, with MVP and up.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **MVP+ Kit**: a Chroma Key, a Shard Key and 1,000 Prism Shards. Every 24 hours, with MVP+.
Check `/ranks` early. The first rank up comes quickly, and its spawner is the start of a farm.
Rank kits pay Prism Shards every day, which adds up for [crafting](/wiki/smp/crafting/).
